checks.text: The page shows the heading "Pantry Inventory" and, with no items, the text "No items in your pantry yet".

Filling the field labelled "Item name" with "Olive Oil", the field labelled "Quantity" with "2", choosing "bottles" in the select labelled "Unit", and clicking the button "Add item" adds a table row containing "Olive Oil", "2 bottles", and a status badge "Fresh"; the text "No items in your pantry yet" is gone.

After adding "Olive Oil" (2 bottles, no expiration date), clicking the row's "Edit" button opens the form with "Item name" pre-filled "Olive Oil", "Quantity" pre-filled "2", and "Unit" set to "bottles"; changing "Quantity" to "5" and clicking "Save" updates the table row to show "5 bottles".
Adding an item "Milk" with Quantity "1", Unit "carton", and an expiration date set to yesterday via the DatePicker shows a status badge "Expired" in its table row.

With "Milk" (expired) and "Olive Oil" (fresh) in the list, selecting "Expired" in the filter select labelled "Status" hides the "Olive Oil" row and shows only the "Milk" row; selecting "All" shows both rows again.
Typing "olive" in the search box labelled "Search items" filters the table to show only the row containing "Olive Oil"; clearing the search box shows all rows again.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard that begins with "Item name,Quantity,Unit,Expiration date,Status" and contains a line with "Olive Oil,2,bottles,,Fresh".
Every table row has a button labelled "Delete <item name>". With "Milk" and "Olive Oil" present, clicking "Delete Milk" removes that row and the table shows only "Olive Oil".
Reload keeps the item "Olive Oil" with quantity "2 bottles" and status "Fresh" visible in the table after a full page reload.
